explanation: OEIS A382590 (a(n) = a(n−1)b(n−2) + a(n−2)b(n−1), b(n) = a(n−1)b(n−2) − a(n−2)b(n−1), a(0) = b(0) = b(1) = 1, a(1) = 2): 'For any k > 1, if you take the k-th prime factor of each term, you get an eventually periodic sequence' (proof sketched by T. Tao on MathOverflow). abPair implements the mutual recurrence over ℤ. kthPrimeFactor k takes the k-th smallest distinct prime factor of |a(n)|, defaulting to 1 when there are fewer, a reasonable reading consistent with the file's checks (second prime factors of a(6) = 20, a(7) = 896 are 5, 7). The statement is eventual periodicity for each k ≥ 2. Faithful.
